name: Ripio wCOP
oneLiner: WCOP is Ripio's Colombian-peso wrapped fiat stablecoin, issued and redeemed through Ripio's wFIAT on/off-ramp infrastructure against local-currency reserves.
collateral: Colombian-peso fiat cash deposited in a Colombian bank account, backing Ripio wCOP one-to-one against the Colombian peso per Ripio's wFIAT token certification
pegMechanism: WCOP is issued and managed by Ripio against local fiat reserves, but ordinary holders do not have a documented direct redemption right with the issuer. Exits depend on secondary-market liquidity, Ripio on/off-ramp flows, or issuer-managed market operations.

wFIAT whitepaper v1.0: attestations may be published periodically; wFIAT do not represent e-money and carry no redemption right

review.evidence: All mint-capable role holders verified via hasRole() across Ethereum, Base, BSC, Polygon, Gnosis, and Worldchain at block 25295015. EOA 0x466c02e2 confirmed via eth_getCode. Safe 0x2b839174 confirmed as 4/7 Safe v1.4.1 with no modules or guard. Minter-router contracts 0xd168cfbb and 0x46167cb0 confirmed as AccessControl contracts whose admins are the same EOA and Safe. Supervision review (2026-08-08): wCOP has its own independent certification - Pablo Eduardo Soto, CPA (CPCECABA Vol. 275 Folio 153) reconciled 104,898,654 wCOP outstanding across six chains against COP 107,966,549.02 in a Colombian bank account as of 2026-03-31 - so reserve evidence is attestation-backed. Reconciliation stays unknown because Ripio labels it the first attestation of wCOP collateral, the whitepaper's cadence language is permissive, and later-period certifications return 404. No prudential regime applies to the unnamed Ripio group affiliate that issues wFIAT.

Ethereum WCOP proxy and verified implementation

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: At fixed 2026-07-15 blocks Ethereum 25534997, Base 48646186, Worldchain 32373046, BSC 110049753, Polygon 90251163, and Gnosis 47208124, every tracked WCOP proxy resolved to 0x6f6206fac28d9f60d221a63aae5fb5c3a9ea6652 and returned paused() = false. On each route, 0x466c02e2cc67b81a696af5afdb61605c41fe247b held both PAUSER_ROLE and UPGRADER_ROLE. Ethereum, Base, and Worldchain run the verified pausable LatamStable variant, so that EOA can halt all ERC-20 updates; BSC, Polygon, and Gnosis run the verified compliance variant, which additionally exposes blockUser, unblockUser, and setEnforceBlocklist and rejects a blocked sender or receiver in _update when enforcement is enabled. This is an asset-wide direct freeze conclusion from all six tracked routes, but address-specific blocklisting is only asserted for BSC, Polygon, and Gnosis. The V9 transfer review is resolved by the direct pause/blocklist mechanisms, not a permissioning-adapter inference. Ripio's public GitHub organization did not expose a wFIAT/LatamStable Solidity repository, and Archive.org returned no snapshot for the reviewed English wFIAT page; deployed explorer source and fixed RPC evidence remain sufficient. The issuer's March 2026 collateral certification was reviewed as transparency evidence, not as access-control proof.

reserves.name: Colombian-peso cash deposited in a Colombian bank account

sources.label: Independent public accountant certification for wCOP - March 2026

reserveReview.rationale: The March 31, 2026 certification reconciles 104,898,654 outstanding wCOP across six chains and COP107,966,549.02 of collateral to a Colombian bank statement, then certifies that all outstanding tokens are backed by Colombian pesos at a financial institution in Colombia. The engagement is expressly a certification, not an audit or review, and the bank and account terms are not disclosed. Write-time re-open 2026-07-31: Ripio's current wFIAT page still reports the same wCOP circulation and Colombian bank-account collateral, while the certification remains the latest dated assurance artifact; no newer composition or named custodian was published.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Independent public accountant certification of the wCOP collateral as of March 31, 2026
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No reserve asset class is unclassified; the Colombian financial institution, account type, and withdrawal liquidity are undisclosed.

notices.title: Peg grouped as Other
notices.message: COP is not yet a first-class Pharos peg-currency enum, so WCOP is grouped under OTHER while the DefiLlama price and circulating-supply path admits the asset at runtime.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: wCOP has reviewed cross-chain route evidence through Across, an intent/liquidity framework rather than issuer-native settlement. The route is scored as liquidity/intent because execution and available bridge liquidity are material to cross-chain movement.
bridgeRouteRisk.reviewer: Codex bridge route review; Kimi P2 control cohort dc-6 (lead usde-ethena)
